paragraphs: Tax Management Associates, Inc. assists state and local taxing officials in their day to day duties of administering ad valorem taxation. Founded in 1979, the company works with state and local governments on revenue enhancement initiatives. Private auditing for local government started when its Business Personal Property Audit Division was founded in 1987.

The company page lists administrative support and personal property listing assessment, business personal property tax auditing, and homestead exemption fraud detection among its ad valorem tax solutions. Two further lines are discovery of non-reporting businesses and customization of ad valorem projects.

The homepage says the audit service has performed more BPP audits than any other company in the nation. Homestead work is presented as combating fraud and abuse through verifying homestead exemptions. An online portal provides real-time updates, statistics and detailed information for each service. Administrative support services supplement a local tax office with the firm's professionals.

quote.text: For 45 years, Tax Management Associates has been in the business of assisting state and local taxing officials to administer ad valorem taxation.
